<!--
PR titles become the squash-merge commit on `main`, so the title MUST be a valid
Conventional Commit, e.g. `feat(core): add log-entry repository`.
Keep PRs small and single-purpose (ideally < ~300 changed lines).
-->

## Problem

<!-- What user problem does this solve? Who has it? Link the issue. -->

## Approach

<!-- How you solved it, and which alternatives you rejected and why. -->

## How I tested it

<!-- Commands run, cases covered. For core logic, prefer a test over a screenshot. -->

## Screenshots / recording

<!-- For UI changes. Delete if not applicable. -->

## Risks / rollback

<!-- What could break? How would you undo this? Any data-format implications? -->

## Follow-ups

<!-- Anything deliberately left out of scope, as a checklist or issue links. -->
